dedupe_keys.name: caus configurational analysis of urban systems

description: CAUS is a hybrid of cellular automata and agents that tries to represent how the population of Brazilian coastal cities spreads over space, using network analysis metrics as a sign of how attractive each area is. It was published under the user name gkdalcin on CoMSES in December 2023 for the GAMA platform. Coverage: Brazilian coastal cities. Access: free code on CoMSES. Licence: Apache-2.0. Caveats: the listing gives little documentation; the author is known only by a user name. Simulation uses are urban growth scenarios that place population and buildings, which can feed exposure studies of coastal flooding and sea level rise. Related records: the Fire-WCISG informal settlement model and the Toronto urban form measures.
inputs: Street network and network analysis metrics
Land cells of a coastal city
name: CAUS: Configurational Analysis of Urban Systems
outputs: Spatial allocation of population over time
